hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Asia, northeast of Thailand, west of Vietnam || mostly rugged mountains; some plains and plateaus || landlocked; most of the country is mountainous and thickly forested; the Mekong River forms a large part of the western boundary with Thailand || Resources: timber, hydropower, gypsum, tin, gold, gemstones || Exports: electricity, fertilizers, gold, garments, paper (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly rugged mountains; some plains and plateaus || Southeastern Asia, northeast of Thailand, west of Vietnam

climate.excerpt: tropical monsoon; rainy season (May to November); dry season (December to April) || floods, droughts

economy.excerpt: lower middle-income, industrial Southeast Asian economy; high inflation due to 2022 currency depreciation brought on by persistently high debt; new Laos-China railway and dry port; rising inequities; ongoing labor shortages || Exports: electricity, fertilizers, gold, garments, paper (2023) || Industries: mining (copper, tin, gold, gypsum); timber, electric power, agricultural processing, rubber, construction, garments, cement, tourism
